text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a chronic wound on your right lower leg; can you tell me how long it has been there and what it looks like? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, REQUEST TEST: Erythrocyte_Sedimentation_Rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood work and ESR results are reassuring as they show no signs of active systemic infection or severe inflammation. Given your leg wound has not healed, do you have any numbness or a history of diabetes that might affect sensation and circulation? REQUEST TEST: HbA1c, REQUEST TEST: Ankle_Brachial_Index.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: HbA1c: NORMAL READINGS; Ankle_Brachial_Index: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: Those results rule out diabetes and significant peripheral arterial disease, which narrows the cause. Can you describe the color of the wound and whether you notice any hair loss on your right foot? REQUEST TEST: Tissue_Culture, REQUEST TEST: Serum_Vitamin_B12.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Tissue_Culture: No growth of pathogenic bacteria; Serum_Vitamin_B12: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: With no signs of infection, diabetes, peripheral artery disease, or vitamin B12 deficiency, I need to check your ankle reflexes and sensation specifically for neuropathy. REQUEST TEST: Monofilament_10g, REQUEST EXAM: Ankle_Reflexes.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Monofilament_10g: NORMAL READINGS; Ankle_Reflexes: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: Those reflex and sensation tests are normal, which effectively rules out diabetic neuropathy as the primary cause. To determine if this is a venous stasis ulcer, can you describe the appearance of your right foot and ankle, and do you have swelling in that area when you stand? REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Leg_Vein_Ultrasound, REQUEST TEST: D-Dimer.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Right_Leg_Vein_Ultrasound: Evidence of venous reflux and obstruction in superficial and deep venous systems of the right leg; D-Dimer: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
The ultrasound confirms venous reflux and obstruction, which is the hallmark of venous insufficiency. While your D-Dimer is normal, I need to confirm if you have a history of deep vein thrombosis or observe "weeping" exudate and hyperpigmentation around the wound to finalize the diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer
